actus.title: Louis Burton :  I only eased off the throttle twice
actus.excerpt: Louis Burton was a happy man when he got to the pontoon in Pointe-à-Pitre. He danced exubebrantly on the trampoline of his giant Ultim having just taken third on his first Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe in the Ultim class after just a few months of sailing aboard Ultim Armand Thiery.

actus.title: Still chasing the dream, but with fraying nerves
actus.excerpt: TBetween thunderstorms, rough seas, violent winds, and unexpected calms, the six fleets are racing in very different conditions. As the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe enters its second week the Atlantic seems as determined as ever to make every mile a battle.

actus.title: The Laperche route to victory
actus.excerpt: On a well-seasoned trimaran that he knows like the back of his hand, Tom Laperche was fast in all conditions, agile in his transitions, and sharp and commanding right from the start of the race. When confidence is combined with talent and hard work, the result is unstoppable. Way to go, maestro!
